subject: RFC for multi-language support in FTS (#1279)
reason: The change is documentation-only: it adds rfc/multi-language-support.md (a proposal document for future multi-language FTS support) and excludes that file from the typos checker in .config/typos.toml. No source code, build configuration, or runtime behaviour of the module changes, so the change and parent builds are behaviourally identical and no scenario can reach anything the change altered.
